input.quote: 21.1 Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the Fees paid or payable by Customer under the first Order Form during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim.
input.rationale: The structure of Section 21 is acceptable: the cap is expressly mutual (21.1), indirect and consequential damages are mutually excluded with a helpful direct-damages list (21.2), and "Excluded Claims" (21.3) keeps confidentiality, data protection and security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement outside the cap. The failure is the cap base: "Fees" is defined at 1.5 as only the "Implementation Fee", which 1.6 fixes as a one-time USD 12,000 charge in the first Order Form, and 21.1 narrows it further to that first Order Form, so recurring subscription and services charges are excluded and the cap is an illusory USD 12,000 — below the six-month floor and in walk-away territory. The redline resets limb (a) to fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and adds the USD 1,000,000 limb, and widens the 21.3 payment carve-out from "undisputed Fees for conforming Services" to Customer's payment obligations, leaving mutuality and the carve-outs untouched.

ops.oldText: 21.1 Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the Fees paid or payable by Customer under the first Order Form during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim.
ops.newText: 21.1 Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of (a) fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000.

ops.oldText: Customer's obligation to pay undisputed Fees for conforming Services is not damages and is not limited by this Section.
ops.newText: Customer's payment obligations are not damages and are not limited by this Section.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] "Fees" is defined as only the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee in the first Order Form, so the 21.1 cap is illusory; we have reset limb (a) to fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and added the USD 1,000,000 limb, and widened the 21.3 carve-out so Customer's payment obligations generally are not damages. Mutuality and the Excluded Claims carve-outs are unchanged.
proposal.summary: 21.1 cap basis reset to greater of 12 months' fees or USD 1,000,000; 21.3 payment carve-out widened to Customer's payment obligations
